title: Dynamic Calculator
keywords: Runs Basic, Scientific and Atomic lanes in one validated hollow shell

blocks.text: Runs Basic, Scientific and Atomic lanes in one validated hollow shell. The lanes share output storage, rather than maintaining three independent output inventories.

rows: Build the controller-relative shell described in Multiblocks.
Put Basic inputs in positions 1–2, Scientific in 3–4, Atomic in 5–7.
Supply FE and keep shared outputs clear.
Wait for the scheduled structure check after correcting a missing wall.

blocks.text: An occupied interior, wrong corner material, unloaded shell position or blocked shared output can stop all lanes.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
